# Acme Chat

> Acme Chat is a self-hosted conversational agent platform: people in one organization and its teams chat with AI agents that work in isolated sandboxes.

This is the Acme Chat user guide for agents and people. Each link below is one page as Markdown; https://chat.example.com/llms-full.txt has every page in one file. The same pages are at https://chat.example.com/docs for people.

## For agents

- [Using \[Kobe\]](https://chat.example.com/docs/agents/use.md): How agents read the guide.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://chat.example.com/docs/getting-started.md): Sign in, pick an agent and send a first message.

## Team admin

- [Admin from a conversation](https://chat.example.com/docs/agents/admin.md): What admins can do.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://chat.example.com/docs/glossary.md): Words Kobe uses.
